L1 rot_right -> eye images.convention: body frame x forward, y left, z up; azimuth + = left (tasks/t0_stimuli.py)

L2 eye images -> FlyVis eye.code: camera_rays iterates ('LEye_cam', 'REye_cam') -> eye 0 = left; FlyVis batch row 0 -> group 'L' (sense/vision_boundary.py BoundaryEyes)

L3 FlyVis eye -> boundary side.note: (T4a+T5a)-(T4b+T5b) window mean rate per eye; T4a/T5a prefer front-to-back motion

L4 boundary side -> FlyWire side.documentation: FlyWire Codex FAQ (codex.flywire.ai/faq): neuron side is decided by soma position; neuropil and neuron side annotations are from the fly's perspective; the FAFB images were left/right inverted during acquisition and all annotations and labels in CAVE and Codex were inverted to correct this.

L5 FlyWire side -> bridge.note: real F3b-3 FlyWire DN table and the BANC Codex DN table; one interval of unit counts on one side

L6 bridge -> BANC DN side.note: BANC side = Codex Soma side (the side the model uses); FlyWire side = flywire_annotations.tsv side of the first listed match; neurons with a center / unknown side on either side are left out. fafb_nblast_match is reported, not a criterion.

L7 BANC DN side -> BANC MN side.note: DN and MN sides are the same Codex Soma side column of one dataset; the rule of section 1 decides whether an MN's soma side is its muscle side

L8 BANC MN side -> mapping side.imaged_side_note: Lindsay imaged the right side; the signs are stated for the ipsilateral wing, so they apply to both sides under mirror symmetry
L8 BANC MN side -> mapping side.mapping: A_side = A0 + G sum_m s_m r_{m,side}; s_m = effect on the ipsilateral (same-side) amplitude; dA = A_L - A_R > 0 turns right; S > 0 = syndirectional (scripts/f4_design_numbers.py)
L8 BANC MN side -> mapping side.model_turn_convention: turn_to_amplitudes(turn_bias > 0) -> A_L > A_R, docstring 'turn right'; tests/test_arena_wing.py::test_turn_sign_in_wrench: yaw torque < 0 (right)
